steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-system
steps.eval: (() => { const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')]; const t=els.find(e=>/aircon system/i.test(e.textContent)); if (t) t.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); return t ? 'found' : 'missing'; })()

steps.name: click-plan-aircon
steps.eval: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/plan aircon/i.test(x.textContent||'')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'missing'; })()

steps.name: report-placed
steps.eval: (() => { const its=window.__store.getState().items; return JSON.stringify({ fcus: its.filter(i=>i.defId==='aircon-unit').length, condensers: its.filter(i=>i.defId==='aircon-condenser').length }); })()

steps.name: frame-ledge
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const c=s.items.find(i=>i.defId==='aircon-condenser'); if (c) { s.selectItem?.(c.id); s.setSelectedItemIds?.([c.id]); return 'selected '+c.id; } return 'none'; })()
